This product combines 1500mg of MSM, 700μg of Vitamin A, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 10μg of Vitamin D, 28mg of Ginkgo leaf extract as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 1500mg MSM, 700μg Vitamin A, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 10μg Vitamin D, 28mg Ginkgo leaf extract

  • MSM

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Ginkgo leaf extract
    • May help with joint and cartilage health

2 times a day2 tablets per servingWith water

MSM labelled (1500mg / 2000mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 2000mg), 80~180%

Ginkgo leaf extract labelled (28mg / 2000mg), 80~120%

  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
